description: Hand-authored SOC evaluation cases. Ground truth is composed from the alert payloads themselves and MITRE ATT&CK technique definitions (attack.mitre.org). No ground-truth field was generated by any LLM. Severity bands follow the project convention: low=2-4, medium=5-7, high=8-11, critical>=12.
ground_truth_sources: alert payload fields (indicators, rule mitre ids)

rule.description: sshd: Attempt to login using a non-existent user

ground_truth.expected_direction: Correlate additional failed SSH logins from 198.51.100.77 across hosts; check whether any attempt later succeeded; consider blocking or rate-limiting the source.

cases.notes: Single visible failed SSH login for a non-existent user from an external IP; classic brute-force/password-guessing indicator (T1110).

rule.description: Possible password spraying against cloud accounts: many authentication failures for different users from one source

ground_truth.expected_direction: Enumerate targeted accounts, check for any successful authentication from 203.0.113.50, review MFA bypass attempts, block the source.

cases.notes: Many distinct usernames failing authentication from one external source is the signature of password spraying (T1110.003).

rule.description: Web server: suspicious .jsp file upload to webroot followed by HTTP POST requests to the uploaded file

ground_truth.expected_direction: Quarantine/remove the uploaded file, review webserver logs for source activity, check process executions spawned by the app server user, look for additional webshells.

cases.notes: File upload to webroot followed by POSTs to it is server-side webshell behavior (T1505.003), typically following exploitation of a public app (T1190).

rule.description: Windows: new scheduled task created by non-interactive session running from Temp directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Inspect the scheduled task definition and binary, check binary signature and origin, review recent process lineage that created it, hunt the same task on other hosts.

cases.notes: New scheduled task from a Temp-directory binary in a non-interactive session is classic scheduled-task persistence (T1053.005).

rule.description: sshd: sudoers file modified adding NOPASSWD entry

ground_truth.expected_direction: Verify who modified /etc/sudoers and from where, determine whether svc-backup has NOPASSWD root, check shell history and recent logins for the modifying account.

cases.notes: A NOPASSWD sudoers entry grants passwordless privilege escalation (T1548.003, Sudo and Sudo Caching).

rule.description: Windows: PowerShell launched with encoded command from Word document directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Decode the -enc payload in a sandbox, review winword.exe child process tree, collect the script block logging, check persistence and network callbacks from the host.

cases.notes: Office spawning an encoded PowerShell command is a malicious-document execution pattern (T1059.001 with obfuscation, T1027).

rule.description: Firewall: single host contacted 200+ distinct ports on one destination in 60 seconds

ground_truth.expected_direction: Confirm whether the source is an authorized scanner, review which ports answered, check for follow-on connection attempts to open services.

cases.notes: High-port-count connection pattern is network service scanning (T1046); internal single-source scan is commonly low-severity pending context.

rule.description: Windows: vssadmin delete shadows executed followed by mass file extension changes

ground_truth.expected_direction: Isolate the host from the network immediately, identify the ransomware process and patient zero, check backup integrity, scope the blast radius via EDR before remediation.

cases.notes: Shadow-copy deletion plus mass file renaming is destructive ransomware preparation (T1490 Inhibit System Recovery, T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact).
